result.evidence_quote: Critically, OVV-03 synergized with B7H3- or HER2-targeted CAR-T cells, inducing superior tumor regression and prolonged survival in orthotopic models.
result.rationale: The study directly evaluates an experimental glioblastoma treatment, including combination therapy with CAR-T cells, tumor regression, and survival outcomes. It also investigates antitumor mechanisms involving apoptosis, immune activation, and PD-L1 regulation.
